source_notes: The chapter is not merely a 'weights and measures' chapter; it opens with the purpose and scope of the Saṃhitā and then develops pharmaceutical/clinical paribhāṣā.

The digital Sanskrit witness shows verse-number discontinuities in the displayed text around sections; AaptaKosha must preserve source numbering and reconcile missing/displayed-number issues against the base edition before importing verse records.
BharatKosha explicitly identifies the text as a 32-chapter Saṃhitā and gives the traditional total of 2,600 ślokas.
Do not convert traditional māna into modern metric equivalents at the canonical-text layer. Modern equivalents belong only in a separately labelled educational/reference layer.
